notes: Seven faults from a full A-to-Z test round, two of them quietly taking features away from you. The AI coach's setup reader would open any file it was handed a path to, including GOAT's own config, and read your keys and tokens back to the model; it is now fenced into the sim's telemetry and setup folders, where the tools that WRITE a setup have always been. Clicking a sim tab silently disabled your Virtual Best: the reference list reloaded without a car or track, GOAT picked a lap from a different circuit, recorded it as your choice, and from then on a session opened with no reference at all - no delta colours on the map and no corner tree. The corner tree also vanished on any lap with an incident, because a corner you went off at carries no lights by design and the page did not expect it, and when no reference was chosen it claimed to be analysing your laps indefinitely instead of saying it was waiting. The Corners window drew its new-track progress bars through its own title with the phase names overlapping and the first one off the left edge. Compare opened with an empty lap list for the right-hand side, and two background lookups were publishing your fastest clean lap to the community. The background tray mode had never started at all - it looked for its icon in a folder no installed build has. And the session list stopped reading all 246 telemetry files before filtering by date: 55 seconds down to under three.
